name: Introduction
description: Leon introduces himself and remembers basic information about you.

introduce_leon.description: Introduce Leon and greet the owner.

remember.description: Save a newly stated owner's name or birth date. Do not use this action for questions asking what the saved name is.

owner_birth_date.description: The owner's birth date as an ISO date or precise date string.

get_owner.description: Answer questions asking for the owner's saved name or basic profile information, such as 'what is my name?'.

remember_relationship.description: Save a relationship explicitly stated by the owner, such as 'my girlfriend is Coralie'. Do not use this for the owner's own name.

get_relationship.description: Answer questions asking who the owner's partner is, such as 'who is my girlfriend?'.
